subject: shiny-server, multiple users, sending files, sessionID/user token

messages.author: 689bc5eab59b4e7e
messages.subject: shiny-server, multiple users, sending files, sessionID/user token
parts:
Hi,

i have a shiny app, which is doing some raster analyzes using the 'raster' package. I want to deploy it for multiple users with shiny-server (open source). I already found out, that shiny-server uses one r-session at a time for multiple users. As I would like to send/export some of my raster-layer results to another app/interface (which is not r shiny) I need to find a way to allocate the result-layer to the user who created them. 
Is there some sort of sessionID or user token, which is used by r-shiny to allocate users to inputs and outputs that I can read-out and use? Or is there any other solution to pass a dataset with a certain filetype from r-shiny to another HTML/Javascript/CSS interface, which can allocate the respective user?

Thanks
